# ClickPDF — Full Site Guide

Canonical homepage: https://www.clickpdf.net/
Publisher: Click Digital Services
Public PDF tools: 21
Published Markdown articles: 231

## Overview

ClickPDF is a browser-based suite of PDF utilities. The tools cover document organization, optimization, conversion, text extraction, metadata, signatures, and protection. The tool list below is generated from the active public tool registry; hidden tools are excluded.

## Document processing and network requests

For supported PDF tools, document file contents are processed locally in your browser on your device rather than uploaded to ClickPDF's document-processing service. This describes document processing only: the website may still make standard network requests for its code, fonts, workers, images, and other page resources. Enabled advertising or other third-party features may also make standard requests and receive associated connection metadata under their own policies. This is not a claim of zero network traffic or anonymity. Processing capacity depends on the tool, browser, device memory, and file size.

PDF operations may use significant browser memory and processing time, especially for large or image-heavy files. Results and supported features vary by tool, PDF structure, browser, device, and available memory. Scanned documents may require OCR; extraction quality depends on the scan and available OCR resources.

### Merge PDF Online — Combine Files in Your Browser
URL: https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/merge-pdf/
Description: Merge PDFs online, reorder them with drag and drop, and download one file. Processing runs in your browser; page resources may still make requests.
Key capabilities: Browser-Based File Processing; PDF Page Content; Browser Processing; Local PDF Processing
Typical workflow: Add the PDF files: Select at least two PDF documents from your device or drop them into the merge workspace. → Set the document order: Drag files into sequence or use the available sort controls before combining them. → Merge and review: Create and download the combined PDF, then check page order and any links, forms, or annotations you need.

Typical workflow: Select a PDF for analysis: Open the scanned or text-based PDF whose page details or text you need to inspect. → Run the available analysis: Start OCR for scanned content and review the page count, dimensions, and extracted text shown by the tool. → Copy or download the result: Check the recognized text, then copy it or save the available text output; the source PDF is not rewritten as searchable.

### Protect PDF Online — Use ClickPDF Encryption
URL: https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/protect-pdf-password/
Description: Encrypt PDF files in your browser with ClickPDF Protect. This custom wrapper is not standard PDF password protection; open it with ClickPDF Unlock.
Key capabilities: Zero-Knowledge Architecture; Browser Web Crypto; Brute-Force Resistant; ClickPDF-Specific Format
Typical workflow: Choose the PDF: Select the document you want to place in the ClickPDF Protect format. → Set a password: Enter a password in the protection workspace and check it carefully before creating the protected file. → Download the protected file: Save the output and retain the password; use ClickPDF Unlock to open this ClickPDF-protected format later.
Common questions: Does Protect PDF add a standard PDF password? | Can Adobe Acrobat or another PDF viewer open the protected output directly? | What happens if I forget the password? | Is the source PDF overwritten when it is protected? | Is this the same as redacting sensitive text? | Where can I open a file created by ClickPDF Protect?

### Unlock PDF Online — Open ClickPDF-Protected Files
URL: https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/unlock-pdf-password/
Description: Unlock files created by ClickPDF Protect with the correct password. This tool does not remove unknown passwords or unlock arbitrary standard PDF encryption.
Key capabilities: Browser-Based Decryption; Preserves File Integrity; Password Required; Cross-Device Compatible
Typical workflow: Select the protected file: Open the file created by ClickPDF Protect in the Unlock PDF workspace. → Enter its password: Type the password set when the file was protected and check for typing errors. → Decrypt and save: Run the unlock process and download the resulting PDF, then open it to verify the pages.
Common questions: Can Unlock PDF remove a password from any PDF? | Do I need the same password used during protection? | Will a wrong password recover or reset the file? | Can I open the protected file in a normal PDF reader first? | Does unlocking change the protected source file? | Are protected file contents sent to a document server?

URL: https://www.clickpdf.net/tools/sign-pdf-online/

Typical workflow: Open the PDF to sign: Select the document and go to the page where the visible signature mark belongs. → Create and place the mark: Draw, type, or upload a PNG signature image, then position and resize it on the page. → Download and verify: Save the signed copy and check that the mark is correctly placed on the intended page.
